paper.title_en: Spin in Heavy-Ion Collisions: Experimental Overview
paper.abstract_en: Polarization phenomena and spin dynamics in heavy-ion collisions have attracted considerable interest since the first experimental observation of global spin polarization. Over the past few years, particle polarization has emerged as a rapidly growing field, with new measurements that have stimulated intense theoretical efforts to understand the puzzling experimental results. In this contribution, we review recent progress in experimental measurements of hyperon polarization and vector-meson spin alignment.
